desc:
MINI FRUITFUL PUFFS: Discover big fun and delicious fruity taste in every bowl of these miniature whole grain cereal puffs

GLUTEN FREE: A gluten free cereal with no artificial flavors or colors from artificial sources; Pair with your choice of milk or enjoy by the handful as a crispy snack

ORGANIC & NON GMO: USDA Certified Organic cereal and made with Non-GMO Project Verified ingredients

MADE WITH WHOLE GRAIN: 18g of whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily)

CONTAINS: One 11.1 oz cereal box of Cascadian Farm Organic Mini Fruitfuls Cereal
features:
Key Features:

Fruity Flavor & Crunch

Colorful, fruit-flavored O’s made with a blend of organic corn and oat—great for both breakfast and snacking.

Certified Organic & Non-GMO

Made with USDA Organic ingredients and free from genetically modified organisms.

Gluten-Free

A safe and tasty option for those with gluten sensitivities.

No Artificial Additives

Contains no synthetic colors, flavors, or preservatives—only natural fruit flavoring.

Kid-Friendly Shape & Taste

Fun, ring-shaped cereal that kids enjoy, with a sweet yet natural taste.

Benefits:

Wholesome Ingredients

Made with organic whole grains and natural flavorings, offering peace of mind for health-conscious families.

Great for Quick Meals or Snacks

Enjoy it with milk for a traditional breakfast or dry for an on-the-go snack.

Supports Balanced Diets

Contains whole grains, fiber, and small amounts of essential vitamins and minerals.

Eco-Friendly Choice

Made by a brand that emphasizes sustainable farming practices.
ingredients: Whole Grain Yellow Corn Meal*, Cane Sugar*, Yellow Corn Meal*, Whole Grain Purple Corn Flour*, Sunflower Oil*, Sea Salt, Calcium Carbonate, Annatto*, Natural Flavor*. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. *Organic
